summary: OPUS-AUTHORED (SYNTH, the reconciler). Nine readers, ~150 raw rows, deduped to 96 pending items across ten stages. The headline the owner needs: the arc is NOT mostly done — roughly 60-72 chair-class cars remain across 7-8 gates, and three of the four largest items (L-DEFAULT, the Remembrance reader, READERREVIEW Car 4's fix cars) have never been sized by anyone. The single longest pole is SEAT-7/8 + irregularForce (≈4 cars, its own consist, the only item the lighting charter says adds days to the critical path). Two structural facts dominate the plan: (1) the LIGHTING WAVE does not cover the dossier state-prose corpus at all — CONFIRMED, zero hits for stateProse/DS-ECO/DS-GEN across all 436 charter lines — so the 64 dark blocks (2,185 authored variants shipping in the bundle and reaching no reader) are a parallel track nobody has funded inside the wave's bill; and (2) the GOLDEN freeze machinery exists on no product tip at all and sits 197 commits behind, though its rebase price was MEASURED small (1 of 43 migrated files drifted, no overlap at the migration sites). Since eight of the nine readers took their measurements, the §891 train grew a 19th car: O2GATE committed mid-survey (450f7dbb7), curing the paid-surface leak. The most valuable thing the owner can do in one minute is answer four sentences — CS-9, the characterDrift door, O-5 and O-11 — which between them unblock CHARSET Car 2, ENC-3 (~17 files), the wave's drift row, the Remembrance reader and the whole L-MAT car.
totals: CHAIR-CLASS CARS REMAINING: 60-72, across 7-8 gates/landings. By stage — A §891 landing: 0 build cars (3 register acts inside one landing). B HORIZON-DARK: 3 firm + 2 optional/droppable (WORKER Car 3 droppable, TUNEREG Car 4 optional) + 3 zero-byte long-running measurements. C desk wiring: 11-16 cars (DESK re-derived 6 dispatchable leaf items at 8-13 cars, plus {complexity}, the walker arm and the fail-closed cure). D ENCOUNTERS: 5-6. E LIGHTING WAVE: 18-24 (the charter's own sum is 12-16 prerequisite cars of which SEAT-7/8 alone is ≈4, plus L-DEFAULT unpriced, plus 3 small flips, plus 2 zero-byte chair sessions, plus the prose-car rebase, EP-1, the fences car and the witness). F machinery/hygiene: 8-9 small. G GOLDEN freeze: 11 (7 GOLDEN cars + COVERAGE 1-3 + the trailer caller + the freeze act). H W-ARMS: 3 chair + 2 owner-gated. J review-phase fix cars: UNSIZED by construction. GATES: (1) the §891 landing, (2) HORIZON-DARK G5, (3) the desk series — no source says whether it is one landing or several, (4) ENCOUNTERS, (5) the LIGHTING WAVE (ONE landing by charter, but SEAT-7/8 rides its OWN consist, so 2), (6) the GOLDEN freeze G6, (7) W-ARMS, (8) the review phase's fix consists. LONGEST POLE: SEAT-7/8 + irregularForceEnabled — the lighting charter prices it at 2-3 days on the critical path before the freeze, calls it the largest single funding decision in the wave, and it is the ONLY item any source says adds days. It was chair-ruled FUND at §882.1 under TIME IS NOT THE CONSTRAINT, and CONFIRMED unbuilt (irregularForceEnabled has 0 hits over src/tests/scripts/docs at BOTH ca651d54b and 15c6368a6). Runner-up: L-DEFAULT, the wave's centre of mass, a six-hunk commit series whose file count no source gives. NOT THE POLE, despite looking like it: the seven GOLDEN cars 197 commits behind — the GOLDEN reader measured the rebase and it is cheap. NOBODY HAS SIZED, and the owner should treat these as unknown rather than small: L-DEFAULT (explicitly "no file count is given"); the Remembrance reader RR-2 ("the inventory prices it nowhere" — the 1-2 car figure is a declared GUESS); the characterDrift funnel (a GUESS from the W-LIVES charter); READERREVIEW Car 4's fix cars (unknowable until the reading runs); WRWALKER Car 4's triage of ~301 identities; DESK-2's general desk beyond "3-5 cars" (PLAUSIBLE it exceeds the 800-line domain ceiling and needs splitting — unmeasured); the three CAPACITY evidence measurements beyond the ~2.3 h plateau receipt.
